betterquesting:10.desc:8:
The lottery is a system, not a button. Two default pools: Neko at 5 coins a draw, Shimmering at 1 shimmering coin a draw. From 30 failed draws, soft pity adds +5 percent weight per extra draw to high-rarity entries; hard pity forces EPIC-or-better at 50 draws on the Neko pool, 30 on the Shimmering pool.

The counter only resets when you actually hit EPIC or above — and it is counted per team per pool, so one member grinding the wheel moves the guarantee closer for everyone.

Draw with the crossover budget, not against it.
